## Gateways and proxies
These sit in the request path, so they can enforce budgets before tokens are spent.

content.text: for traces with cost attached, Langfuse or LangSmith fit best, and for spend control in the request path, a gateway like Portkey, LiteLLM or Cloudflare AI Gateway fits best.

Many teams pair a gateway with an observability tool.

Many of these "best of" lists are written by vendors who rank themselves first. Check pricing and features on each tool's own site before you commit.
